My plan now focuses on the data structure and Canvas implementation.

I'm now implementing the click-to-select-then-drag approach, keeping it simple. For export, I'll iterate through the `elements` array. I'll generate HTML `<div>`s with IDs, and CSS for absolute positioning based on `x`, `y`, `width`, and `height`. I'll keep the generated Javascript static for reliability. I'm now focusing on UI refinements, like adding welcoming Japanese text and soft color schemes. I'm prioritizing user-friendly text editing with content, size, and color controls, plus simple shape options (rectangles, circles, and colors). I'm now incorporating anchoring. I will stick with the x, y coordinates for the UI, but calculate a CSS "anchor" based on element placement during the drag-and-drop actions.
